description.narrative: AFIDEP is coordinating the 9th African population conference starting from 20th to 24th May 2024. This is a forum where research studies on population studies are shared, and policies discussed. Some the policy makers involved in the conference are members of Parliament (MPs)/legislators. AFIDEP has been at the forefront in mobilizing the leadership of parliamentarians and other policy makers in championing sexual and reproductive health as well as population and development issues in Malawi and across Africa. The MPs formed the Parliamentary and policy forum which will take part this conference. The 9th African Population Policy will promote the leadership of parliamentarians and other policy makers in championing reproductive health and population and development issues. The Forum is expecting 15 Malawian ministers and local MPs and 30 ministers and MPs drawn other African countries, including the African Network of Population and Development Caucuses. The Norwegian Embassy in Lilongwe is requested to support expenses for 9 international members of parliament. The rest will be funded through other sources.
